normalRule: normalizedPlaneNormal is in x/h/z coordinates. Apply inverse transpose diag(1/s,1/H,1/s) and normalize, or compute normals from independent world-space contract vertices. Contact normals are horizontal world directions.
triangulationRule: triangulation is the prescribed geometric partition; orientedTriangles has outward winding. Changing a diagonal cannot count as a different architecture.
decorationRule: Only upward ground paving at .004H belongs in D. All architectural roofs/walls belong in W/O.
